title: Chris Pratt to Star in Sci-Fi Family Drama ‘The Traveler,’ Inks First-Look Producing Deal at Paramount (EXCLUSIVE)
summary: Chris Pratt is setting up his next sci-fi adventure: starring in Paramount Pictures’ big-screen adaptation of “The Traveler,” based on the novel by Joseph Eckert. The film is part of the new first-look, three-year producing deal Pratt inked at the studio through his Indivisible Productions banner. …
